content:
tara: Heads-up: onboarding customer hit a "works locally, fails in edge" issue. Their TS sampleapp imports the SDK as default and the edge preview throws "TypeError: SDKClient is not a constructor".

tara: Minimal repro I added to the mono repo under `examples/edge-optimizedeps-repro`. Steps:
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood-internal/edge-repros.git
cd edge-repros/examples/edge-optimizedeps-repro
pnpm i
pnpm --filter sampleapp run build
pnpm --filter sampleapp run preview:edge
```
Failure only after production build. Dev server (vite dev) works.

ben: Can you paste the import site and package.json for sdk and sampleapp? suspect optimizeDeps or preserveModules.

tara: sampleapp import: `import SDKClient from 'redwood-inference-js'`
sampleapp package.json: `{"name":"sampleapp","type":"module","dependencies":{"redwood-inference-js":"workspace:packages/sdk"}}`
sdk package.json: `{"name":"redwood-inference-js","main":"dist/index.cjs.js","module":"dist/index.esm.js","types":"dist/index.d.ts","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.esm.js","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js"}}`

chloe: Two common traps: vite optimizeDeps prebundles CJS and our preview harness runs an esbuild pass for worker compatibility. The chain can flip export shapes. Does your ESM file export a default? `dist/index.esm.js` should have `export default` if you expect default import semantics.

tara: The ESM file currently only has named exports (`export function createClient(...) {}`), no `export default`. Types (dist/index.d.ts) erroneously declare `export default function createClient(...)` so TS autocompletes the default import, which is inconsistent.

ben: That mismatch explains the confusion. Workarounds while we fix types/publish: 1) update sampleapp import to `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-inference-js'` then `const Client = (Redwood as any).default ?? Redwood.createClient ?? Redwood;` 2) in vite config add `optimizeDeps: { exclude: ['redwood-inference-js'] }` to avoid prebundle. Both are ugly but unblock customers.

tara: I tested `optimizeDeps.exclude` — it prevents the prebundle and the edge preview then sees the expected function in many runs. I'll add that snippet to the repro README.

chloe: For longer-term: SDK should either (A) provide a true ESM default export in `dist/index.esm.js` and sync types, or (B) change types to only include named exports and guide users to `import { createClient }` so there is no interop reliance. Publishing ESM-first with conditional exports prevents bundlers from guessing.

dev-bot: Created RD-5102: "sdk: align ESM build and types (default vs named)" <link>.

preview-bot: Note: will add a diagnostic that scans uploaded bundles for `exports.default =` and warns if present (RD-5103).

tara: I'll push a tiny README update in the repro with both quick workarounds and the build commands. Posting PR link here once done. Thanks all.
